scenario: Preview and create a three-value colour enum with explicit display text, inspect identities and unsaved state, refuse collision and invalid names, and guard active transactions.
limitations: Small three-value enum fixture; no large-enum or every display-name rejection test.
Creation stays in memory; save/reload and use in a compiled Blueprint were not exercised.
PIE and off-game-thread guard source-reviewed; active transaction refusal tested in editor.
Engine callbacks may create their own undo records; there is no tool-owned atomic undo guarantee.
Creation failures may leave a partial unsaved asset; no new rollback guarantee.

confirmed_failures.finding: Creation inside an active transaction succeeded and created a package. Other native assertions passed.

fixes: Refuse asset creation before mutation outside the idle editor/game-thread context.
Expose idle-editor requirement in live help and preview output.
Clarify preview versus edit effects and simplify enum API comments.
checks: Live preview/edit help includes path, values, display text and save behavior.
Preview does not create an object.
Empty, duplicate case-insensitive, reserved and malformed names refuse without creating a package.
Active transaction refuses with no package created.
Three names, consecutive numeric values, display text and sentinel read back correctly.
AssetDescribe separates dirty state from on-disk existence.
visual_review: Not applicable: enum data and returned text checked directly; no layout/capture contract.
